plan.title: Rebrand to titan-chordpro-gen
plan.narrative: Flip external identity (repo, PyPI name, live docs, CLI primary) from `titan-chordpro-lib` to `titan-chordpro-gen` while keeping the Python import package `titan_chordpro` stable (Option A). Coordinate the GitHub/folder rename window with `curta` pins and sibling path links. Design SoT: `design.md` (critic Approved, user Approved 2026-08-28).

principles.title: External identity, stable import
principles.body: Change what people install and type (`titan-chordpro-gen`); do not rename `import titan_chordpro` in this plan.

principles.title: Live surface only
principles.body: Update README, roadmap H1, CLAUDE.md, install scripts, live product docstrings, CHANGELOG Unreleased. Leave `docs/research/**` and `docs/superpowers/**` untouched.

principles.title: Staged cutover with a same-day consumer window
principles.body: Merge metadata/docs PR in this repo first; then operator renames GitHub + local folder; same operational day update `curta` pins/paths and `chordpro-viewer` NAMING link.

principles.title: Own initiative — not F2
principles.body: Do not piggyback on the Phase C quality loop. Anchor `rebrand-gen` (or explicit ad-hoc) before code edits.

principles.title: Operator owns irreversible renames
principles.body: GitHub repository rename and local directory rename are operator steps; agent prepares strings and verifies after.

glossary.definition: Keep Python import package `titan_chordpro`; only distribution/repo/docs/CLI surface rename
Console script `titan-chordpro` kept for compat (same entry)
Installable/product-facing docs and strings (not historical research)
Same-day operator GitHub+folder rename + curta pin/path PR
